a:r.a:t: Identity verification forces a hard trade-off
Businesses want fast onboarding, but every shortcut can increase fraud, compliance risk, or manual review cost.
Long KYC flow creates drop-off before signup is complete.
Fake IDs, edited documents, and replay attacks are hard to catch.
Teams need clear evidence for review, audit, and compliance.
Manual KYC is slow. Basic digital KYC is easy to attack.
